Professional Summary
QA Automation Engineer with a focused track record in building and maintaining automated test suites for web applications. Experienced in creating reliable test frameworks, integrating tests into CI pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve release quality and reduce regression risks.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Test Automation, Postman, Playwright, JUnit, Git, Jira

Work Experience

QA Automation Engineer, Ledgerly (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Implemented Playwright-based end-to-end test suites covering core transaction workflows, reducing manual regression time by introducing repeatable Test Automation that caught critical issues prior to release.
- Developed JUnit test runners and integration with CI to execute automated suites on pull requests, improving early defect detection and shortening feedback cycles.
- Authored Postman collections and automated API checks for payment endpoints, enabling faster validation of backend changes during sprints.
- Maintained and extended Selenium-based legacy tests to ensure coverage during migration to Playwright, coordinated results tracking in Jira.

QA Automation Engineer, Orbit Health (Aug 2022 - Dec 2024)
- Built and maintained Selenium Test Automation for patient portal and clinician dashboards, increasing automated coverage of user flows and stabilizing weekly releases.
- Designed JUnit-based component tests and integrated them into Git-driven CI pipelines to provide consistent validation on merges and nightly builds.
- Created and maintained Postman test suites for REST APIs used by mobile and web clients, enabling smoke validation and faster triage of incidents.
- Introduced Playwright prototypes for flaky Selenium scenarios, reducing test flakiness and improving reliability of automated regression runs; tracked issues and test plans in Jira.
